verified_improvements: Authoritative production deployment on main is READY and canonical alias serves HTTP 200.
Main CI completed successfully after a real Arabic classifier regression was found and fixed.
UI derives external-channel truth from runtime registry instead of claiming configured channels are connected.
Arabic and English locale coverage is enforced by tests across the full owner preview.
Gulf/UAE Arabic deterministic golden tests now cover booking, rescheduling, cancellation, location, hours and temporal phrases.
Translation workload is bounded and translation prompts treat message content as data rather than instructions.
Production response carries CSP, clickjacking, MIME-sniffing, referrer and permissions hardening headers.
Focus-visible, mobile touch-target, reduced-motion, dialog and live-region accessibility baselines are present.
hard_gates_before_real_customer_launch: Automated multi-tenant isolation with real persistence
Privacy consent, retention, export and deletion implementation
Real E2E action verification and idempotency for non-reversible operations
Production observability, tracing, SLOs and failure taxonomy
Full AI eval harness with measured hallucination/tool-selection/escalation metrics
Clinic-specific legal/regulatory approval before real patient data
remaining_p1: Turn synthetic workflows into closed-loop verified operations behind hard gates
Verify channels and calendar rather than configuration presence
Add full AI evaluation datasets and scorecards beyond deterministic intent tests
Measure LCP/INP/CLS and API/AI latency rather than assigning operational performance credit
Externalize inline CSS/JS so CSP can remove unsafe-inline
Localize accessibility-only labels and date/day rendering for strict screen-reader parity
Implement Owner Hours Saved and Safe Autonomy Rate from real events
